svg.aria-label: A cross-reference to a procedure that was repealed
svg.text: A cross-reference to a procedure that was repealed
DR 4/2022 inserts art. 31-A. Its n.º 2 sends an applicant without the visa to arts. 88 and 89.
The regulation is amended for the last time
DR 1/2024, the seventh amendment to DR 84/2007. It does not touch art. 31-A.
The transitional rule is widened, not the route
Lei 40/2024 protects proceedings already begun and people already contributing.
The paragraph is refilled with something else
Lei 61/2025 gives art. 89 a new n.º 4, about certified business incubators.
Two years and three months of a regulation naming a procedure that does not exist.
The regulation has not been amended since January 2024. The paragraphs it names were repealed in June 2024.
Every figure checked against a primary source on 7 September 2026
